scenario: checking an important detail about public transport
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Checking an Important Detail About Public Transport
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: public transport — checking an important detail about public transport
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to checking an important detail about public transport; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Grace if the train is late today.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Grace hôm nay tàu có bị trễ không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Grace. Is the train late today?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Grace. Hôm nay tàu có bị trễ không?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: That is a relief, thank you.
turns.vietnamese: Vậy thì tôi yên tâm rồi, cảm ơn chị.
